summary: Psyence Biomedical's Texas subsidiary TIRC signed a binding term sheet on September 25, 2026 with related party PsyLabs for an exclusive U.S. license to pharmaceutical-grade ibogaine know-how; PsyLabs becomes exclusive supplier and TIRC exclusive U.S. wholesaler/distributor. Consideration comprises up to ~US$1.3M development and regulatory milestones for the first drug candidate, an annual exclusivity fee creditable against royalties starting after first FDA approval, a low single-digit net-sales royalty, and margin-sharing. Definitive agreement deadline is November 30, 2026. Related-party structure and narrow U.S. rights are key governance and execution watch items.
